categories.main_business_segments: Narada Power primarily operates in three segments: new power storage, communication and data center storage, and resource recycling. It provides lithium-ion and lead-acid batteries, integrated systems, and services for energy storage applications globally. The company also develops hydrogen energy equipment and recycles battery materials to support sustainable development.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced lithium iron phosphate battery technology, system integration, and operational maintenance capabilities. It develops large-capacity battery cells, liquid-cooled storage systems, and battery management systems (BMS) with global safety certifications. Narada also invests in solid-state and sodium-ion battery technologies and employs environmentally friendly recycling processes for lithium and lead materials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Narada serves customers in new power storage, communication and data center storage, and civilian storage sectors. Its clients include telecom operators, data centers, financial institutions, and energy companies. The company’s products and systems are used in grid frequency regulation, peak shaving, backup power, and renewable energy integration across industrial, commercial, and residential markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally, covering over 160 countries and regions. Key markets include China, Europe, North America, Australia, Japan, South Korea, India, Greece, Sweden, and Finland. Narada maintains localized sales and service centers to support its international expansion and customer base.
categories.supply_chain_position: Narada operates across the entire lithium and lead battery supply chain, from raw material recycling and battery manufacturing to system integration and after-sales services. It has established a closed-loop industrial chain encompassing battery materials, product applications, operational services, and resource recycling, positioning itself as an integrated midstream and downstream player.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on 'Three Integrations and One Fusion' strategy emphasizing industrial integration, sales-service integration, global integration, and ecosystem fusion. R&D priorities include enhancing battery capacity, safety, and lifespan, advancing solid-state and sodium-ion batteries, developing hydrogen energy solutions, and improving recycling technologies. Narada collaborates with universities and research institutes to maintain technological leadership and accelerate commercialization.
categories.revenue_model: Narada generates revenue primarily through direct sales of lithium-ion and lead-acid batteries, integrated energy storage systems, and recycled battery materials. It also earns income from providing system integration, operational maintenance services, and licensing of technology. The company’s sales are predominantly direct, supported by strategic partnerships and global distribution networks.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Narada is a leading global player in the energy storage industry, ranked third in China’s global market shipments for energy storage systems and lithium batteries for communication and data centers. It competes with major domestic and international battery manufacturers and system integrators, leveraging its comprehensive industrial chain and technological innovation to maintain a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Narada reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 7.98 billion, a 45.56% decrease from the previous year, primarily due to market competition and raw material price declines. The company experienced a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 1.5 billion. Despite short-term challenges, Narada continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D, with ongoing projects to increase lithium battery production capacity and system integration capabilities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Narada emphasizes its integrated industrial chain advantage, combining battery manufacturing, system integration, and resource recycling to offer comprehensive energy storage solutions. Its products feature high safety standards, long cycle life, and advanced management systems certified globally. The company’s commitment to technological innovation, quality, and global localized service enhances customer value and differentiates it in the competitive energy storage market.
